run_teleoperation_gamepad: run the teleoperation script to control a Franka Panda robot using a gamepad
run_teleoperation_keyboard: run the teleoperation script to control a Franka Panda robot using keyboard input
run_teleoperation_debug: run the teleoperation script in debug mode with the base PandaPickCube environment
run_teleoperation_rgb: run the teleoperation script with rgb_array render mode for headless operation
run_teleoperation_config: run the teleoperation script with a custom controller configuration JSON file
